answer: What survives to the vine is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on recursive zk-SNARKs for scalable verification. Work waits on the bridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round. Written in a concise bullet points, data-driven conclusions register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
